main.OID: skip: constant (-1 on every row), a GIS export artefact
main.DATA: skip: row identifier, used only as the last sort key for a total order
main.RAILNAME: chart-lines, kpi:lines, insight:latest — one line per name, short labels for the axis
main.SECTID: kpi:sections, chart-lines — sections per line (with RAILNAME), in the line table
main.SECTNAME: skip: free-text section names; shown in the map popups from the geo input and searchable in the explorer
main.SUBSECID: skip: sub-section ordinal within a section, a sort key only
main.XSTART: skip: start point (ITM); the map draws the real line from the geo input
main.YSTART: skip: start point (ITM); the map draws the real line from the geo input
main.XEND: skip: end point (ITM); the map draws the real line from the geo input
main.YEND: skip: end point (ITM); the map draws the real line from the geo input
main.AUTHCODE: skip: CBS code twin of AUTHORITY
main.AUTHORITY: chart-cities, kpi:cities, insight:city, insight:underground — streets table lists the cities each street runs through
main.METROPOLIN: chart-place, chart-nodes, chart-dirs, chart-len, insight:size, insight:placement, insight:axis
main.STREET: chart-streets, insight:elevated — grouped per metropolitan area; a numeric value is shown as a street code
main.MAIN_LINE: chart-svc, chart-lines, insight:services — the main service line, with ADD_LINES
main.MAIN_LINEC: skip: numeric code of the MAIN_LINE + ADD_LINES combination, which the page shows by name
main.ADD_LINES: chart-svc, insight:services — additional service lines sharing the track
main.YEAROPEN: chart-lines, kpi:latest, insight:latest — recorded opening year in the line table; no chart, since the Gush Dan value (2011) looks wrong
main.OPERATFIRM: chart-lines — operator column of the line table
main.MANAGFIRM: chart-lines — managing company column of the line table
main.D_UPDATE: chart-lines — last update date per line, in the line table
main.VLEVEL: chart-lines, chart-cities, kpi:under, kpi:street, insight:underground, insight:elevated
main.STATUS: skip: constant (מסילה קיימת); the dataset holds existing track only
main.Shape_Length: chart-lines, chart-cities, chart-place, chart-svc, chart-dirs, chart-len, chart-streets, kpi:km, insight:size — metres (ITM)

geo.XSTART: skip: start point (ITM); the geometry itself is drawn
geo.YSTART: skip: start point (ITM); the geometry itself is drawn
geo.XEND: skip: end point (ITM); the geometry itself is drawn
geo.YEND: skip: end point (ITM); the geometry itself is drawn
geo.AUTHCODE: skip: CBS code twin of AUTHORITY

geo.MAIN_LINE: skip: charted from the datastore table (chart-svc)
geo.MAIN_LINEC: skip: code of the service-line combination
geo.ADD_LINES: skip: charted from the datastore table (chart-svc)
geo.YEAROPEN: skip: shown from the datastore table (line table)

geo.MANAGFIRM: skip: shown from the datastore table (line table)
geo.DIRECTION: skip: charted from the datastore table (chart-dirs)
geo.D_UPDATE: skip: shown from the datastore table (line table)
geo.VLEVEL: map-network — dashed line underground, thick line elevated; popup
geo.WLOCATION: skip: charted from the datastore table (chart-place)
geo.DIR_TYPE: skip: shown from the datastore table (table-track)
